method: Same aec09d6 core source ABBA original-A/candidate-B/candidate-B2/original-A2. Both one/native bank, current mask and peak, same allocation/raster/draw/cache/artist code; only the complete CardMipUploader module differs at the exact current PaintedCardBatches import. Complete uploader-module candidate splits warm changed CPU-to-scratch regions. Cache/CPU ownership/cost changes are fully reported because unchanged adaptive cache logic may respond to changed timing. New attempted partial-copy counters are not required to equal original; original has no measured field. GPU rasterization/mip-copy counts, upload bytes, page layout, geometry and render order remain strict invariants. All raw samples pooled across four lifetimes per policy, not averaged quantiles. All 24 PNGs are decoded and compared at zero RGBA tolerance; original-A supplies six phase/lifetime image oracles.

limits: ABBA reduces simple order drift but only four lifetimes and 48 real samples per policy do not prove all hardware or stable tail distributions. Complete wall is GPU-completion/scheduling, not GPU nanoseconds/FPS.

Complete uploader module is isolated on aec09d6, not integrated production. Warm changed regions split into <=64KiB public copies; first/recovery full uploads and GPU mip/compaction copies are outside that ceiling. Original has no measured partialUploadCopyCalls counter. New attempted-call count is reported, and source-identical adaptive cache timing/counters may change. No per-call timing/profiler: whole-frame ABBA cannot prove a smaller maximum single-copy duration or a specific GPU wait fix.
Full/World3D/Canvas timings are nested/residual and cannot be added. Cold real samples remain in headline values. No allocation profiler or GC attribution.
